Talk to cute waifu on Android. Waifus are anime-themed personal assistants.
Detective is a chat game where the player gets randomly paired with either another player or an automated chat bot. This application uses the BOT Libre API.

Social Butterfly allows you to anonymously chat with random strangers through Google Talk. If you use Gmail, you already have Google Talk.
An easy way to add live chat support to any website, leveraging public chat protocols (via the tropo API) and the Campfire chat room.
Down or Not checks a website from 3 locations in the WatchMouse network and decides if a site is indeed down or not.

OggChat is a live chat solution for website support and sales that integrates with Google Talk and GMail. It incorporates features such as custom chat windows and skills based routing, but routes all chats directly to each operator's Google Talk acc
Shows the positions and status of Jabber - GTalk users and allows personal places to be marked and commented.
Flash-based interface to Google Talk. Allows you to chat without a client install. Gtalkr also has its own API.

BOT libre allows you to create your own artificial intelligent chat bot, train them, and share them with others.The BOT libre API allow you to chat with your bots over REST.You are free to use this API for personal, commercial, or recreation usages.

From the site: As long as you adhere to the requirements of the XMPP specs, you should be able to connect to the Google Talk service. Other clients that can connect include [[http://gaim.sourceforge.net/ GAIM]] and [[http://www.ceruleanstudios.com/learn/ Trillian Pro]].

HipChat is an instant messaging service designed for companies and teams. The platform allows internal communication with chat rooms and file sharing. HipChat is private and secure with a self-building buddy list.

The mesibo Client-side API allows developers to integrate mesibo's real-time chat features into their iOS, Android, and web-based applications. This API's methods cover one-on-one messaging, group messaging, voice and video calls, file sending, and user profile management. This API is only accessible using mesibo's iOS and Android SDKs.

The mesibo Server-side REST API allows developers to communicate with mesibo to administer their accounts, manage apps, manage users and groups, send messages, access statistics, and so on. mesibo is a service that allows users to add real-time messaging, voice, and video chat to their mobile apps and websites. It provides both one-on-one and group communications and can also be used to add chatbots.
